name: hermes-conduit
description: Conduit — native SwiftUI iOS client for Hermes Agent

issues.title: Chats created in Conduit with a model picked can't be opened in Hermes Desktop (`session.resume` → not_found)
Enhancement: Workspace explorer code editor, file tabs, relative paths, copy items and drag-to-chat
Bug: Today conversations missing and sidebar date groups appear empty on MacBook
Read Aloud skips the middle of a reply
[Performance Audit] Connect, reconnect, and foreground chains serialize independent round trips after the socket is up
Feature: Live Kanban task and agent activity indicators in chat and conversation sidebar
iPhone: chat-open stall + scroll frame drops on a 1,900-message session
UX: Auto-focus chat composer when opening a conversation on MacBook

latest_release.name: Conduit iOS 2.4.0 (build 269)
latest_release.body:
- Bot workstreams: answer a bot's question with one tap from the chat list; question-only chips now count as needing you
- Linked Rooms: each bot's room tools in Group Info, room names follow tool changes, 16 MB files in rooms with others, and copies show who left or was removed
- Approvals: redacted cards show the queue's own card first, stale answers go back to pending, and returning to the app reads fresh approvals
- Transcript: rows re-measure after environment changes (Dynamic Type, orientation), including off screen, without re-measuring on scroll back
- Audio: handles iOS 27 interruption notifications and deactivates the session cleanly (issue 826)
- Reliability: scheduled jobs read again after a reconnect and a cancelled read is not a failure; the project sheet explains failed reads with Try Again; held notification failures no longer claim a chat could not be restored
